description: This file defines a utility object 'StringUtils' with methods for joining a LinkedList into a String and splitting a String into a LinkedList, delegating work to other utility classes.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: Utility singleton object providing string manipulation methods.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Concatenates the elements of a LinkedList into a String.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList of substrings.
